one_line_answer.text: You need to know candidates' characteristics to plan and organise assessment for their needs.

cites.quote: You need to know the characteristics of the candidates so that you can plan and organise assessment according to their needs.

bangla_explanation: Assessment plan করার আগে জানতে হবে candidate কারা, তাদের কী special needs আছে।
না জানলে candidate-কে disclose করতে উৎসাহ দিন, enrolment information আর files check করুন।
Files দেখার সময় confidentiality মনে রাখবেন।
Language, literacy, disability, age, gender, cultural background — এগুলো সব special needs হতে পারে।

example.en: A trainee at a garments training centre cannot read well. The assessor checks enrolment information first.
example.bn: আগে জানলে assessor উপযুক্ত পদ্ধতি বেছে নিতে পারেন।

short.prompt: List five candidate needs that may require consideration in competency assessment.
short.modelAnswer:
Special needs of candidates may relate to their:
1. Level and experiences of previous learning and assessment
2. Language, literacy and/or numeracy levels or needs
3. Physical impairment or disability (hearing, vision, voice, mobility)
4. Intellectual impairment or disability
5. Religious and spiritual observances
Others: motivation, learning progress, cultural background, age, gender.

keyPoints.text: Candidates should be encouraged to disclose any equity or additional support needs.

cites.quote: Candidates should be encouraged to disclose if they have any equity or additional support needs

keyPoints.text: Check enrolment information and speak to relevant workplace personnel or other trainers.

cites.quote: Speak to relevant workplace personnel or other trainers

keyPoints.text: Special needs include literacy, numeracy or language difficulties and non-English speaking backgrounds.

cites.quote: with literacy, numeracy or language difficulties, those who come from non-English speaking backgrounds
